body:
Kanban cruise-queue card 9988. New match-on-user-defenum support in emit_go.go (goDefnRetInfo Kind=enum/EnumName, knownEnumNames, emitGoMatchEnum handling real N-ary exhaustiveness -- every real variant of the scrutinee's specific enum covered exactly once, generalizing beyond Result/Option's own fixed 2-clause shortcut). 5 new tests incl. a real end-to-end build-and-run proof (3-variant Light enum). go test: 108/108. BURROW commit dd406c5. Put into real production use the same day: PARENA/stdlib/idunapro/cli_mod.prn's HealthError/Result design (which needed a Go-side .Tag-reading workaround, healthErrorMessage) replaced wholesale with a real HealthStatus enum + classify-health/health-message/health-exit-code, all consumed via real match. PARENA commit a35a691, IDUNA_PRO commit 95b3a89 (healthErrorMessage workaround deleted entirely). Live-verified against IDUNA's actual running :8080 (healthy -> exit 0) and an unreachable host (exit 1). Real, honest, still open: struct construction, (Vec SomeStruct) element types, and the fuller multi-subcommand CLI itself (one real subcommand, not yet a full 'emily for business' CLI). session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e

⚓ ☃
title: Card 9988: match on a user defenum shipped, put into real production use same day (idunapro health redesign)
